title: parley participant registry
description: participants.json: who is in the parley. Chair is a role, not a species: zero or more participants of any non-tool kind may hold it (tools may not; tools/validate.py enforces that).

base_branch.description: The integration branch for repo-capable participants (default: the first chair's branch, else main).

role.description: chair: may decide, sees every record, never owes review. Any human or model; zero or more per parley.

model.description: Model string as the harness reports it. Required for kind model.

harness.description: How this participant is reached: claude-code, codex-cli (the CLIs, under their own logins — agentic in a worktree when the participant has the repo capability, text-only with tools off when it does not); llama-server (a local OpenAI-compatible server); command (any program: projection on stdin, records on stdout); inbox (files); human (see mode); dispatch.

capabilities.description: Defined values: repo (has a worktree; can read code and the log directly), shell, web. Others are free-form.

latency.description: Sets the dispatcher's per-turn wait and how the projection is budgeted. human: no deadline.

worktree.description: Path of this participant's git worktree, relative to the chair's checkout.

branch.description: Branch this participant commits to; convention parley/<id>.

context_budget.description: Approximate token budget for one projection. Participants with a budget receive summarized projections.

inline_diff_lines.description: Diffs at or under this many lines are inlined in this participant's projection; larger ones are referenced.

command.description: Harness knob: executable (or argv prefix) that invokes this participant. Defaults: claude, codex. For harness `command`, the program that reads a projection on stdin and prints records.

harness_args.description: Harness knob: extra arguments appended to the invocation (permissions, sandbox, model flags).

session.description: Harness knob: resume the participant's CLI session between turns (delta projections) or start fresh each turn (full-log projections).

timeout_s.description: Harness knob: per-turn wall-clock limit; overrides the latency-class default.

endpoint.description: Harness knob (llama-server): chat-completions URL of the local server.

extra_args.description: Harness knob: arguments appended after the defaults (or after harness_args): model selection, reasoning effort, anything else. Does not disturb the sandbox/permission defaults.

env.description: Harness knob: environment variables for the CLI process (e.g. MAX_THINKING_TOKENS for claude-code).

mode.description: Human harness only: how the dispatcher reaches this person. exit: stop the run and print their block; prompt: an interactive prompt (when they are the operator, `parley run -i`); inbox: .parley/inbox/<id>.md in, <id>.reply.md out.

effort.description: Harness knob: reasoning effort. claude-code → --effort, codex-cli → -c model_reasoning_effort (low|medium|high|xhigh|max; codex also minimal).
